01-system-use-cases.title: 01  System Use Cases · Overview
01-system-use-cases.subtitle: The system boundary includes Vue, the Express query service, and both smart contracts. One wallet may fulfill several roles.
01-system-use-cases.scope-note:
Roles and Permissions

Wallet users inherit visitor capabilities; administrators inherit wallet-user capabilities.

The administrator is the NFT contract owner.

Favorites, language, and theme are stored locally.
01-system-use-cases.uml-legend: Solid line: participation  |  Hollow triangle: generalization toward the general role  |  Ellipse: use case  |  Frame: system boundary
01-system-use-cases.scope-foot: A connected wallet is a precondition for on-chain actions. NFT approval is conditional; see the activity diagrams for its execution.

02-market-use-cases.title: 02  Market Use Cases · Details
02-market-use-cases.subtitle: Precondition: a wallet on the target chain. Sellers own the NFT; bidders do not. Withdrawal requires a pending balance.
02-market-use-cases.funds:
Funds Flow

Purchase or bid acceptance:
Seller proceeds → pending balance.

Outbid, withdrawn, or purchase-refunded bids:
Bid amount → original bidder's pending balance.

Withdraw funds in a separate action.
02-market-use-cases.market-legend: Each NFT has one active highest bid. The full bid amount is held in ETH escrow; there is no automatic expiry.
02-market-use-cases.market-foot: Buying, accepting bids, withdrawing bids, and withdrawing funds are separate use cases. Settlement does not automatically trigger withdrawal.

03-overall-activity.title: 03  Overall Usage and Transaction Confirmation
03-overall-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Public browsing needs no wallet. Minting, trading, bidding, transfers, and administration use on-chain transactions.
03-overall-activity.browse:
User · Browse market, details, activity
Search / filter / sort / paginate
03-overall-activity.public:
User · Save favorites or change
language / theme locally
03-overall-activity.connect:
User · Connect or verify wallet / chain
(Connection flow: Diagram 04)
03-overall-activity.choose:
User · Choose an action; check inputs
(Business rules: Diagrams 05–12)
03-overall-activity.confirm:
Wallet · Confirm and submit transaction
Wait for its receipt
03-overall-activity.refresh:
Frontend · Request refresh
Express syncs the index; reload state
03-overall-activity.failure:
Frontend · Explain rejection / failure
User corrects or refreshes, then retries
03-overall-activity.public-note:
Public Queries and Preferences

The browsing API returns minted assets and their state.

Switch instantly between Simplified Chinese and English. Favorites, theme, and language use localStorage.

After connection, query assets, listings, and bids for the current wallet.
03-overall-activity.tx-note:
Shared Transaction Rules

The wallet may reject confirmation. Chain, balance, or contract checks may prevent execution.

A reverted transaction leaves its business state unchanged; an on-chain failure may still cost gas.

Approval is a separate transaction. A later failure does not undo an approval that succeeded.

If confirmation succeeds but refresh fails, reload and verify the state before retrying.

04-wallet-activity.title: 04  Connect and Disconnect a Wallet
04-wallet-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · MetaMask or local demo accounts. Demo mode requires localhost / 127.0.0.1 and Hardhat chain 31337.
04-wallet-activity.entry:
User · Click Connect Wallet
Choose a connection method
04-wallet-activity.injected:
Wallet · Allow account access
Switch chain; add network if missing
04-wallet-activity.demo:
Frontend · Check hostname / chainId
Get a local demo signer via RPC
04-wallet-activity.session:
Frontend · Set signer; save session choice
Load ETH, NFTs, bids, pending balance
04-wallet-activity.disconnect:
User · Disconnect wallet
Clear frontend signer and session choice
04-wallet-activity.failure:
Explain missing wallet, rejection,
or wrong chain; return to connection
04-wallet-activity.wallet-note:
Connection Semantics

Connection provides a wallet address and signing capability.

Disconnection only clears local connection state. NFTs, funds, and on-chain approvals remain.

A MetaMask account or chain change disconnects the frontend and requests reconnection.

If minting starts without a wallet, connect first, then click Mint again.

05-mint-activity.title: 05  Mint NFTs
05-mint-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: wallet connected to the target chain. NetPunks performs final validation and issuance.
05-mint-activity.read:
Frontend · Read mint status and price
Load total supply and wallet mint count
05-mint-activity.quantity:
User · Choose quantity; check total
Total = unit price × quantity, plus gas
05-mint-activity.send:
Confirm mint(quantity)
Send exact total ETH (Diagram 03)
05-mint-activity.mint:
NFT contract · safeMint sequential IDs
Update wallet count, supply, proceeds
05-mint-activity.refresh:
Frontend · Refresh NFTs and mint progress
Admin sees pending mint proceeds
05-mint-activity.failure:
Contract rejects and explains why
Refresh and reconfirm if price changed
05-mint-activity.mint-rules:
Mint Validation

Minting must be open.
Quantity: 1–5 NFTs.
Lifetime wallet count + quantity ≤ 5.
Total minted + quantity ≤ 10,000.
Payment = execution-time price × quantity.

Transferring NFTs does not restore the mint allowance.
An invalid NFT receiver also causes a revert.

06-listing-activity.title: 06  List, Reprice, and Cancel a Listing
06-listing-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: current NFT holder. Listing and bid acceptance request single-token approval only when needed.
06-listing-activity.entry: User · Choose an action in NFT details
06-listing-activity.form:
User · Enter a positive price
Optional buyer address must not be self
06-listing-activity.approve:
Confirm approve(market, id)
This NFT only (Diagram 03)
06-listing-activity.list:
Confirm list(id, price, onlyBuyer)
Check ownership, price, approval
06-listing-activity.listed:
Market · Create / replace listing
Snapshot ownership / approval versions
06-listing-activity.cancel:
Confirm cancelListing(id)
Only the recorded seller may cancel
06-listing-activity.cancelled:
Market · Delete listing
Keep NFT ownership and existing bid
06-listing-activity.refresh: Frontend · Refresh listing and NFT details
06-listing-activity.listing-rules:
Listing Validity

A purchase rechecks seller ownership, approval, and recorded version snapshots.

A transfer invalidates the old listing. Transferring away and back does not restore it.

Approval changes can invalidate a listing. Reapproval alone does not restore it; list again.

07-buy-activity.title: 07  Buy an NFT at the Listed Price
07-buy-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: connected buyer is not the seller. A private listing requires the designated buyer address.
07-buy-activity.view:
User · Open a listed NFT
Check price and private-buyer restriction
07-buy-activity.send:
Confirm buy(id, expectedPrice)
Send the exact confirmed price (03)
07-buy-activity.settle:
Market · Delete listing and active bid
Credit proceeds to seller's pending balance
07-buy-activity.refund:
Market · If a highest bid exists
Credit full refund to its bidder's balance
07-buy-activity.transfer:
Safely transfer NFT to buyer; refresh
Seller / bidder may withdraw later (10)
07-buy-activity.failure:
Invalid listing, changed price, or buyer
Reject; refresh and confirm again
07-buy-activity.buy-rules:
Execution-Time Checks

Listing is valid; market still approved.
Expected price = current listed price.
ETH paid = current listed price.
Buyer is not the seller.
Buyer matches any private restriction.

A buyer who is also the highest bidder still pays the full purchase price. The old bid becomes pending funds.
07-buy-activity.atomic:
Atomic Settlement

Settlement, refund accounting, and NFT transfer share one transaction. Any failure reverts all of it.

08-bid-activity.title: 08  Place, Raise, and Withdraw a Bid
08-bid-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · One highest bid per minted NFT. Full ETH escrow is held by the market; holders cannot bid on their own NFT.
08-bid-activity.entry: User · Open the NFT bidding section
08-bid-activity.bid:
User · Enter a higher bid
Confirm placeBid(id); send full ETH
08-bid-activity.record:
Market · Credit old bid to prior bidder
Record the new highest bid
08-bid-activity.withdrawn:
Market · Verify current bidder
Delete bid; credit pending balance
08-bid-activity.refresh:
Frontend · Refresh highest bid / balances
Withdraw refunded funds separately (10)
08-bid-activity.failure:
Reject low bids, owner bids, invalid NFT
Refresh latest bid before retrying
08-bid-activity.bid-rules:
Raising Bids and Refunds

Raising your own bid still requires the full new amount. The old amount becomes your pending balance; it is not deducted automatically.

Only the current highest bidder may withdraw the active bid. Superseded bids are already pending funds.

Withdrawing a bid does not send ETH to the wallet.

09-accept-bid-activity.title: 09  Accept the Highest Bid
09-accept-bid-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: current holder's wallet, an active highest bid, and approval for the market to transfer the NFT.
09-accept-bid-activity.review:
Holder · Review the highest bid
Confirm the acceptance amount
09-accept-bid-activity.approve:
Confirm approve(market, id)
Approve this NFT only
09-accept-bid-activity.send:
Confirm acceptBid(id, minimumPrice)
Minimum price = the confirmed bid
09-accept-bid-activity.settle:
Market · Delete bid and listing
Credit seller's pending balance
09-accept-bid-activity.transfer:
Safely transfer to current highest bidder
Refresh; seller may withdraw later (10)
09-accept-bid-activity.failure:
Invalid owner, approval, minimum price,
or withdrawn bid: revert transaction
09-accept-bid-activity.accept-rules:
Minimum-Price Protection

Bid amount must be at least the confirmed minimum; the bidder must not be the holder.

Confirmation sets a minimum price, not a fixed bidder. If a higher bid replaces it, execution may accept that higher bid.

Settlement uses the ETH already held in bid escrow. No extra payment transaction is needed from the buyer.

10-withdraw-activity.title: 10  Withdraw Market Funds
10-withdraw-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Entry: My Collection. Market proceeds and refunded bids accumulate in pendingWithdrawals.
10-withdraw-activity.read:
User · Open My Collection
Frontend loads the pending balance
10-withdraw-activity.send:
User · Click Withdraw Balance
Confirm withdraw() (Diagram 03)
10-withdraw-activity.zero:
Market · Recheck balance at execution
Set this address's pending balance to zero
10-withdraw-activity.empty:
No funds available
Button disabled; check again later
10-withdraw-activity.failure:
Revert the whole transaction
Pending funds remain for a later retry
10-withdraw-activity.sources:
Sources of Pending Funds

Sale at a listed price.
Acceptance of the highest bid.
Your bid is replaced by a higher bid.
You withdraw your highest bid.
An NFT you bid on is bought via its listing.

Withdrawal sends all pending funds to the caller's wallet. Ordinary wallet ETH is separate.

Mint proceeds use Diagram 12.

11-transfer-activity.title: 11  Transfer an NFT
11-transfer-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: current holder's wallet. A gift transfer uses ERC-721 safeTransferFrom directly.
11-transfer-activity.entry:
Holder · Click Transfer in NFT details
Enter a valid, nonzero recipient address
11-transfer-activity.move:
NFT contract · Update owner / version
Invalidate the previous market listing
11-transfer-activity.refresh:
Frontend · Refresh ownership / market
No sale proceeds are generated
11-transfer-activity.failure:
Invalid address, ownership, or receiver
Revert; original ownership remains
11-transfer-activity.transfer-rules:
State After Transfer

A transfer does not automatically cancel an existing highest bid. The bidder may still withdraw it.

The new holder may accept a valid bid, or approve the market and create a new listing.

A contract recipient must support safe ERC-721 receipt.

12-admin-activity.title: 12  Mint Administration and Proceeds
12-admin-activity.subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: NetPunks owner wallet. The contract enforces onlyOwner in addition to the frontend gate.
12-admin-activity.entry:
Admin · Open issuance management
Read mint status, price, and proceeds
12-admin-activity.settings:
Admin · Change mint status / price
Confirm setMintSettings(open, price)
12-admin-activity.withdraw:
Admin · Check mint proceeds > 0
Confirm withdrawMintProceeds()
12-admin-activity.saved:
NFT contract · Recheck owner
Update mint availability and price
12-admin-activity.paid:
NFT contract · Check owner / proceeds
Zero proceeds, then send ETH to owner
12-admin-activity.refresh:
Frontend · Refresh settings / balances
New status / price applies to later mints
12-admin-activity.denied:
Frontend · Request the admin wallet
Contract rejects non-owner admin calls
12-admin-activity.admin-scope:
Admin Scope and Failures

Fixed collection cap: 10,000 NFTs.
Fixed lifetime mint limit: 5 per wallet.

Mint proceeds and market pending funds are separate. This admin entry withdraws mint proceeds only.

No proceeds or failed payment causes rejection / revert. A failed payment preserves mint proceeds.

Use Diagram 03 for rejection, transaction failure, or refresh errors.
